title: ROOT Harness Agent Registration Schema
description: Defines the agent registration record for ROOT Harness. Every agent is also registered as a SAGE User entity (shared identifier). The SAGE User provides identity for data-layer operations; the ROOT Harness record provides configuration for execution-layer operations. See ROOT Harness Architecture Reference Sections 2.3 and 4.1.

agents.description: The set of agents registered for this domain instantiation.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier, matching the SAGE User entity ID. Permanent; an agent that is retired is marked inactive but the SAGE User record persists for provenance.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for logs and UI display.

agent_type.description: Agent classification per the two-type taxonomy (CAS-ADR-010). Stewards own canonical artifacts. Orchestrators own coordination lifecycles. Everything else is a tool, not an agent.

owned_artifact.description: For stewards: identifier of the canonical artifact this agent owns. Null for orchestrators. When populated, designates the agent as a steward with exclusive authority over the named artifact. The vault_steward is a specialized steward that owns access to the vault's search and discovery surface rather than a single document.

decision_log_enabled.description: Whether this agent has a SAGE-managed decision log as a companion artifact (CAS-ADR-012). Steward decision logs capture artifact-scoped operational judgment. Orchestrator decision logs capture coordination-scoped judgment.

autonomy_level.description: Decision authority on the five-level scale. 1: fully supervised (human executes). 2: approval-gated (human approves each action). 3: checkpoint-gated (human reviews at checkpoints). 4: exception-gated (escalates only on exceptions). 5: fully autonomous (post-hoc audit only). Assigned per agent per domain; not an intrinsic property of the agent.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities this agent can perform (e.g., 'terminology_audit', 'format_check', 'content_draft', 'vault_search', 'blast_radius_analysis'). Used by orchestrators for dispatch decisions.

policy_ref.description: Reference to the policy configuration governing this agent's behavioral constraints. Must match a policy_id in the policy configuration.

llm_config.description: LLM provider, model, and parameters for this agent's inference calls.

model.description: Model identifier (e.g., 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-haiku-4-5'). Default is Claude Opus 4.6; Sonnet or Haiku appropriate for mechanical tasks.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens per LLM call for this agent.

system_prompt_ref.description: Reference to the system prompt template for this agent. Templates are stored outside this schema (in the domain's configuration directory or as SAGE-managed documents).

active.description: Whether this agent is currently active. Inactive agents are retained for provenance but not dispatched.
